prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Access Saved Desktop Pets & Synced Data", "Logging into your account ensures existing pets are restored instantly and your desktop preferences stay safe."]
1: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Rendering Engine...", "Setting up screen boundaries and overlay permissions so your pet displays smoothly."]
2: ["Select Companion Base & Personality Traits"]
3: ["Choose Instant Companion vs Custom Pet Creation"]
4: ["Reviewing Pet Generation Settings", "Verifying trait rendering and asset integrity before certificate issuance."]
5: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet", "Use the system tray icon and desktop shortcuts to hide, move, or talk to your pet anytime.", "Right-click tray icon to manage pet visibility, sound, and settings."]
6: ["Already have a pet? Sign in with your registered account to restore your pet automatically."]
7: ["Preparing System Tray & Desktop Overlay", "Initializing background processes and desktop shortcuts for quick pet management."]
8: ["For best pet rendering results, upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward."]
9: ["Pick Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Choose Instant Starter for immediate desktop pet setup (under 1 min) or Custom Pet Creation for tailored traits."]
